summary:
Verified all 16 claims against the s129-poolgate image myself, re-running every command and re-reading every load-bearing byte. Result: 11 CONFIRMED, 4 DOWNGRADE, 0 REFUTED outright (one sub-claim refuted inside [11]).

The lane's core structural finding survives adversarial attack and is, if anything, stronger than it claimed. I reproduced independently: thunk!=impl for both UFUNCTIONs (rel32 arithmetic re-derived, not retyped); zero `call [reg+0x2D0]` anywhere in the spawn family via capstone instruction decode rather than the lane's byte regex, over FULL chained .pdata extents; exactly three indirect calls in the 3702-byte core; exactly nine edges to the NULL epilogue, confirmed a second time by an alignment-free byte-wise branch scan that a desynced linear disassembly could not have faked; the 524 image-wide gate-slot count reproduced to the digit; and every callee identification (AActor::StaticClass, ALokiGameState::StaticClass, GetWorldFromContextObject, UWorld::SpawnActor) re-attributed by its own string literals.
